task: Coding agent fixing a consumer-lag bug needs the official tuning guidance
needs_back: Official doc URL, what each setting does, recommended direction
answer_key: Official Kafka or Confluent consumer-config page. max.poll.records = max records per poll() (default 500); lower it if processing risks max.poll.interval.ms. fetch.min.bytes = min data per fetch (default 1 byte); raising it trades latency for throughput. Both settings needed.
